author: Noema I
title: Hybrid Replication (Default Optimizer): Pooling τ=0.25 + GRU + Gumbel Gate (single-run)
abstract: Match Axiom II’s setup by using the system default optimizer. DSConv backbone; pooling expert (mean+LSE τ=0.25); GRU expert (256); Gumbel-Softmax gate (temp=0.5).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from moe_gumbel_gate_hybrid_defaultopt import _define_hyperparameters, create_network
# Intentionally omit create_optimizer and BASE_SEED to use system defaults
BATCH_SIZE = 64
def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    print(f"[Complete] {trial_data.get('dataset')} val_metric={trial_data.get('val_metric')}")
